title: OpenTelemetry 将软件碳强度纳入云原生可观测性信号
english: CNCF presented a keynote at Observability Summit Europe 2026 in Prague on making Software Carbon Intensity (SCI) a first-class signal in OpenTelemetry. The proposal explores treating carbon intensity as part of cloud-native observability, alongside established operational signals. Separately, OpenAI announced the Rosalind Academic Plan for eligible academic labs, sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind and related tools for life-sciences research. Its other updates describe AI-assisted active learning for educators and Agreement Analyzer, developed with Sullivan & Cromwell to identify issues in draft agreements. Together, these items show AI moving into specialized workflows while observability expands toward sustainability-related measurement.
chinese: CNCF 的主题演讲讨论了如何将软件碳强度（SCI）作为 OpenTelemetry 中的一类一等信号，使云原生可观测性能够覆盖碳强度这一可持续性维度。OpenAI 则发布了面向符合条件学术实验室的 Rosalind Academic Plan，并介绍了教育场景的主动学习支持，以及与 Sullivan & Cromwell 合作开发、用于识别协议草案问题的 Agreement Analyzer。
why_it_matters: 对资深运维开发而言，SCI 进入 OpenTelemetry 的讨论意味着可观测性信号的范围可能从性能、可靠性延伸到碳相关指标，AIOps 平台需要考虑如何采集、关联和呈现这类信号。OpenAI 的案例表明，AI 正在进入科研、教育和法律等专业工作流；建设 Agent Infra 时，重点仍是将模型能力嵌入可审计、面向具体任务的工具链。
interview_expression: I see observability evolving beyond reliability and performance toward sustainability-related signals such as software carbon intensity. For AI systems, I would focus on integrating model capabilities into auditable, domain-specific workflows rather than treating the model as an isolated service.

vocabulary.meaning: 一等信号；被作为核心、标准化观测对象对待的信号
vocabulary.example: The keynote explored carbon intensity as a first-class signal in OpenTelemetry.
